text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It's finally time, isn't it? My 
heart is pounding so hard...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I feel like I can convey my 
true feelings!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I will win this race, and—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to bring warmth and a bright, sunny 
feeling to everyone's hearts!
